description: Production pipeline backed by Sarvam AI batch STT (saaras:v3, codemix mode for the Hindi-English mixing field conversations actually have, native diarization with auto-detected speaker count) + translate. Requires SARVAM_API_KEY and the sarvamai package. Select with VOCLYP_PIPELINE_CONFIG=configs/pipeline.sarvam.json. Languages come from configs/languages.json (hi-IN + en-IN today). The diarization stage stays as a fallback: it only labels speakers the ASR left unknown.
